NYC: New York has more stand-up than anywhere else in the country, from late-night club sets in Greenwich Village and Chelsea to big tours at the Beacon Theatre and The Town Hall. LaughsLive lists Gotham Comedy Club, the Comedy Cellar, The Bell House in Gowanus, Brooklyn Improv in Williamsburg, and suburban rooms like Levity Live in West Nyack and Bananas in Rutherford, NJ.
PHL: Philadelphia's comedy runs from Punch Line Philly in Northern Liberties and Helium Comedy Club off Rittenhouse Square to touring headliners at The Met on North Broad and the Miller Theater. Within 50 miles you'll also find the Xcite Center at Parx Casino in Bensalem, plus shows in Princeton, Wilmington, Reading and the Lehigh Valley.
BOS: Boston's comedy scene centers on Laugh Boston in the Seaport and The Wilbur in the Theater District, with big names at the Boch Center and MGM Music Hall at Fenway. LaughsLive also covers the Chevalier Theatre in Medford, City Winery Boston, and shows across the North Shore and into Rhode Island.
BAL: Baltimore stand-up means The Port Comedy Club in Fells Point, the Baltimore Comedy Factory in Canton and Magooby's Joke House up in Timonium, with touring acts at The Lyric and the Hippodrome. Annapolis, Columbia and Frederick shows within 50 miles are included too.
DC: Washington's comedy hub is DC Improv near Dupont Circle, joined by The Comedy Loft of DC, the Lincoln Theatre, Warner Theatre and the 9:30 Club. Across the river and the Beltway, LaughsLive lists The Birchmere in Alexandria, Capital One Hall in Tysons and The Theater at MGM National Harbor.
PIT: Pittsburgh's comedy lineup includes the Pittsburgh Improv at The Waterfront in Homestead, The Comedy Bar at Remo's in Ross Township and Bottlerocket Social Hall, plus touring headliners at Citizens Live at The Wylie and the Cultural District theaters.
CLE: Cleveland stand-up runs between Hilarities 4th Street Theatre downtown, the Funny Bone in the Flats and the Playhouse Square theaters, with club nights in Akron and Cleveland Heights also on the list.
NSH: Nashville's comedy home is Zanies on 8th Avenue South, with newer acts upstairs in The Lab at Zanies and big tours at the Ryman Auditorium and Bridgestone Arena. Shows in Franklin and Murfreesboro within 50 miles are included.
PWM: In Portland, Maine, stand-up happens at Empire Comedy Club downtown, with touring comedians at the State Theatre, Merrill Auditorium and Aura.
CHI: Chicago is home to The Second City in Old Town, plus Zanies, Laugh Factory Chicago in Lakeview and The Comedy Bar in Streeterville. LaughsLive also lists the Chicago Theatre, City Winery, and suburban clubs like the Chicago Improv in Schaumburg and Zanies Rosemont.
ATL: Atlanta comedy spans The Punchline in North Buckhead, Laughing Skull Lounge in Midtown and Helium Comedy Club in Alpharetta, with touring headliners at the Buckhead Theatre, Center Stage and the Fox Theatre.
RIC: Richmond's main comedy club is the Funny Bone in Short Pump, with touring comedians at The National, the Altria Theater and the Dominion Energy Center.
ORF: Hampton Roads comedy centers on the Funny Bone at Town Center in Virginia Beach, with bigger shows at Chartway Arena, the Sandler Center and the Attucks Theatre in Norfolk.
HFD: Around Hartford, LaughsLive lists the Hartford Funny Bone in Manchester, Brew Ha Ha comedy nights, and casino shows at Foxwoods and Comix Roadhouse at Mohegan Sun, plus The Armory at MGM Springfield.
NHV: New Haven-area comedy includes College Street Music Hall and Toad's Place downtown, the Stress Factory in Bridgeport, and shoreline shows in towns like Westbrook, plus the Ridgefield Playhouse.
MIA: Miami comedy runs from the Miami Improv in Doral and Just The Funny on Coral Way to Villain Theater in Little Haiti. North toward Fort Lauderdale and Boca Raton, LaughsLive lists Hard Rock Live at Seminole Hard Rock, the Broward Center and The Parker.
TPA: Tampa Bay stand-up centers on the Funny Bone in Centro Ybor (the former Tampa Improv) and Side Splitters in Carrollwood, with touring acts at the Tampa Theatre, the Mahaffey in St. Petersburg and Ruth Eckerd Hall in Clearwater.
ORL: Orlando's main club is the Funny Bone at Pointe Orlando on International Drive (the former Orlando Improv), with touring shows at Hard Rock Live at Universal CityWalk, The Plaza Live and the Dr. Phillips Center.
CIN: Cincinnati comedy centers on the Funny Bone at Liberty Center in Liberty Township, with touring headliners at the Taft Theatre, the Aronoff Center and Heritage Bank Center.
STL: St. Louis stand-up and improv happen at Helium Comedy Club in Richmond Heights and The Improv Shop in The Grove, with bigger shows at the Fabulous Fox, The Pageant and the Stifel Theatre.
MSP: In the Twin Cities, LaughsLive lists Acme Comedy Co. in the North Loop, Rick Bronson's House of Comedy at the Mall of America and the Brave New Workshop, plus tours at the Orpheum and Pantages theatres.
MKE: Milwaukee comedy includes the Milwaukee Improv in Brookfield, Vivarium and Turner Hall Ballroom, with touring headliners at the Riverside, Pabst and Miller High Life theatres.
DET: Detroit stand-up runs from Mic Drop Comedy in The District Detroit and The Comedy Bar in New Center to Mark Ridley's Comedy Castle in Royal Oak. Big tours play the Fox Theatre and The Fillmore, and Ann Arbor's comedy shows are included too.
DEN: Denver's comedy institution is Comedy Works, with rooms in Larimer Square and Greenwood Village, joined by the Denver Improv and touring shows at the Paramount Theatre.
IND: Indianapolis comedy centers on Helium Comedy Club downtown, with touring headliners at the Old National Centre and Gainbridge Fieldhouse.
AUS: Austin's comedy scene includes Cap City Comedy Club in North Austin and Comedy Mothership on Sixth Street, with bigger tours at the Moody Center and Bass Concert Hall.
DFW: Dallas-Fort Worth comedy includes the Dallas Comedy Club in Deep Ellum, Hyena's in Dallas and Fort Worth, the Addison and Arlington Improvs and Punch Line Irving.
PHX: Phoenix-area stand-up runs between the Tempe Improv and Stand Up Live downtown, with casino and theater shows in Chandler, Scottsdale and Mesa.
LAS: Las Vegas has comedy every night, from Brad Garrett's Comedy Club and Jimmy Kimmel's Comedy Club to headliner residencies at the Encore Theater, Planet Hollywood's Saxe Theater and the Luxor's Atrium Showroom.
LA: Los Angeles comedy runs from The Comedy Store on the Sunset Strip, the Laugh Factory and the Hollywood Improv to Largo at the Coronet and The Groundlings. LaughsLive also covers suburban Improvs in Brea, Irvine, Ontario and Corona.
SFO: Bay Area stand-up includes Cobb's and the Punch Line in San Francisco, Rooster T. Feathers in Sunnyvale and Tommy T's in Pleasanton, plus improv at BATS and Endgames and big shows at The Masonic and in San Jose.
SEA: Seattle comedy includes Emerald City Comedy Club on Capitol Hill, Laughs Comedy Club and Unexpected Productions at Pike Place Market, with touring headliners at the Neptune, Moore and Paramount theatres and Nate Jackson's Super Funny Comedy Club in Tacoma.
HOU: Houston's comedy clubs include the Houston Improv, Punch Line Houston and The Riot in Montrose, with bigger tours at 713 Music Hall, the Bayou Music Center and the Smart Financial Centre in Sugar Land.
SAN: San Diego comedy includes Mic Drop Comedy in Kearny Mesa, The American Comedy Co. in the Gaslamp Quarter and Finest City Improv in Hillcrest, with touring headliners at the Balboa and San Diego Civic theatres.
